note: Photos generated on 2026-11-17 by agy (Antigravity, Gemini image model) with Jeremy's Google AI Pro subscription, for the replica of a computer-vision Reel. Every prompt ended with: 'Fotografía realista, natural, sin texto legible, sin logos, sin marcas de agua.' The *-bordes, calle-amarillo, calle-textura and perro-blanco-32 files are computed from these with ffmpeg (edgedetect, sobel, a yellow threshold, a Laplacian, a 32 × 32 downscale).
